name: LatencyZero 8K
description: Sub-frame input sampling, sharper presentation and audio pacing for weak laptops

boost-enabled.name: Boost enabled
boost-enabled.description: Master switch. Off means the mod measures and changes nothing

poll-rate.name: Input sample rate
poll-rate.description: How often the input thread reads key state. This is the sampling grid, not the device report rate: a mouse reporting at 1000 Hz cannot be read faster than it sends

advance-clicks.name: Apply clicks on their own substep
advance-clicks.description: Hand the jump edge to the game at the physics substep it belongs to instead of waiting for the input queue. Falls back to native if an untracked jump source (touch, pad) is detected

timer-resolution.name: Kernel timer 0.5 ms
timer-resolution.description: NtSetTimerResolution(5000) plus timeBeginPeriod(1) while boost is on

high-priority.name: High process priority
high-priority.description: HIGH_PRIORITY_CLASS for the game process and power-throttling off for it and the input thread

zero-frame-queue.name: Empty the GPU queue (glFinish)
zero-frame-queue.description: Serializes the driver before the swap so no rendered frame sits queued ahead of yours. Cuts presentation delay and costs frames per second

uncap-fps.name: Ask the driver to drop vsync
uncap-fps.description: wglSwapIntervalEXT(0). Tearing appears; the queue depth does not necessarily change under DWM

particle-guard.name: Skip particles under load
particle-guard.description: Stops drawing level particle systems while the measured frame time is over budget

frame-budget-ms.name: Frame budget (ms)
frame-budget-ms.description: Above this measured frame time the particle guard engages, below 80% of it it stands down

audio-low-latency.name: Shrink the FMOD mix buffer
audio-low-latency.description: setDSPBufferSize on the game's own system. Too small a buffer crackles on a weak CPU, so it stays off unless asked for

audio-buffer-samples.name: FMOD block length (samples)
audio-buffer-samples.description: Mix block length; latency is block * blocks / rate

hud-visible.name: Show HUD in PlayLayer
hud-visible.description: Corner label with measured input-to-apply, poll step, frame time and audio latency
